title: Mobile.de Vehicle Scraper
description: Extract vehicle listings from Mobile.de search pages with pagination support.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Optional canonical Mobile.de search URL. Existing URL filters are preserved unless the matching filter input below is provided. If omitted, the actor builds the URL from the structured filters.

location.title: Location or postal code
location.description: Mobile.de location filter, such as Berlin or 10115. Sent as the gn parameter.

make.title: Make
make.description: Mobile.de make name or numeric ID for exact filtering. All current makes exposed by the Mobile.de selector are converted to their verified numeric URL ID, including BMW (3500), Ford (9000), Audi (1900), Mercedes-Benz (17200), Volkswagen (25200), and Toyota (24100).

model.title: Model
model.description: Mobile.de model ID used with a numeric make ID, such as 10 for BMW 320.

year.title: First registration year
year.description: First-registration year or range in Mobile.de format: 2020, 2020:2024, :2024, or 2020:.

price.title: Price in EUR
price.description: Gross price or price range in EUR in Mobile.de format: 10000, 10000:30000, :30000, or 10000:.

country.title: Seller country
country.description: Mobile.de seller-country filter using one of the supported ISO country codes shown below.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of listings
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of listings to collect.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Maximum search-result pages to scan. The actor stops earlier when results_wanted is reached.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use a residential browser session with Germany routing for reliable filtered pagination.
